claims.claim: One collector blog reports some boxes that used to cost about $30 are now listed for $3,000 or more.
Kayou publishes official, licensed My Little Pony cards with Hasbro.
The latest set has 162 unique cards across 10 rarity tiers.
On Etsy, individual rare 2026 My Little Pony Kayou cards are listed for roughly $9 up to $269 (asking prices).
Bootleg boxes exist that lack the Kayou logo and are lower quality.
The cards are slated for Target, Walmart, GameStop, TikTok Shop and other U.S. retailers.
At New York Comic Con 2026, Kayou sold the first oversized KAYOU card ever offered for purchase.

metadata.title: How My Little Pony cards sparked a whole new fanbase 🦄
metadata.description: Official Kayou x Hasbro My Little Pony cards: a 162-card set, rare singles listed up to $269, and one collector blog reporting some ~$30 boxes listed for $3,000 or more. Plus: how to spot bootleg boxes. Sources: comicsbeat.com, ageofthenerd.com, tradingcardarchives.com, etsy.com

issues.text: Why $30 Pony Card Boxes Now List for $3,000
issues.problem: The source says only *some* boxes are listed at $3,000 or more. This title generalizes to all $30 boxes. 'Why' also promises a causal explanation the sources don't give.
issues.fix: Some $30 Pony Card Boxes Now List for $3,000

issues.text: One collector blog says $30 pony card boxes now list for $3,000.
issues.problem: This overgeneralizes. The blog says 'some boxes' that used to cost about $30 are listed for $3,000 or more.
issues.fix: One collector blog says some $30 pony card boxes now list for $3,000.

issues.text: At Comic Con 2026, Kayou sold its first oversized card ever.
issues.problem: The source specifies New York Comic Con 2026 and says it was the first oversized KAYOU card ever offered for purchase. 'First oversized card ever' could be read as the first one ever made.
issues.fix: At New York Comic Con 2026, Kayou sold its first oversized card ever offered for purchase.

issues.problem: It omits the 'offered for purchase' qualifier.

issues.text: Check that logo before a $30 box costs you $3,000.
issues.problem: This implies boxes actually sell for $3,000 and that bootlegs are sold at that price. The source supports neither: prices are 'listed', and nothing links bootlegs to $3,000 sales.
issues.fix: Eyeing a pricey listing? Check for the Kayou logo first.

issues.problem: This visually reinforces the unsupported claim that a bootleg costs $3,000.
issues.fix: Remove the price shift and focus on checking the logo corner.

issues.text: metadata.title: 'Why My Little Pony cards are suddenly a big deal'
issues.problem: This leans toward an unsupported trend/hype claim. The source only says the cards sparked a whole new fanbase.
issues.fix: How My Little Pony cards sparked a whole new fanbase 🦄

issues.text: metadata.description: 'one collector blog reporting $30 boxes listed for $3,000'
issues.problem: It drops the 'some' qualifier and the 'or more' wording.
issues.fix: one collector blog reporting some ~$30 boxes listed for $3,000 or more

issues.problem: This implies a comparison or positioning that no source supports.
